svg.title: A Nested Annual Funnel to $450,000
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-annual-equipment-opportunity-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: A Nested Annual Funnel to $450,000; subtitle: Follow equipment opportunities through five increasingly qualified cohorts.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative annual Base-Case planning cohort, not observed conversion data. Every count represents equipment opportunities from the same original 500-record cohort, deduplicated by owner and asset identifier. Assume 30 settled transactions, each at $250,000 equipment value and a 6% broker commission.; caption: 500 × 40% × 50% × 50% × 60% = 30 settlements. 30 × $15,000 = $450,000 recognized broker revenue. The corresponding $7,500,000 equipment transaction value belongs outside revenue. The 6% overall conversion is a planning assumption.; stages: label: Screened seller opportunities; value: 500 distinct equipment opportunities enter the annual cohort; numeric value: 500.0; detail: Record owner identity, asset identifier, equipment class, location, and disposition timing. Remove duplicate listings before calculating any conversion rate.; label: Signed broker mandates; value: 200 opportunities retain documented seller authority and pricing; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Convert 40% of the original cohort into signed mandates with commission terms, evidence access, and a plausible asking price; retain rejected reasons in the CRM.; label: Qualified buyer matches; value: 100 mandated opportunities secure credible buyer engagement; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Convert 50% of mandated opportunities into buyer-matched assets. Require named purchasing authority, suitable capacity requirements, and a credible funding path; email opens do not qualify.; label: Diligence-ready transactions; value: 50 matched opportunities reach documented diligence readiness; numeric value: 50.0; detail: Convert 50% of buyer-matched opportunities after inspection scheduling, ownership review, negotiated commercial terms, and a documented settlement route.; label: Settled commission events; value: 30 transactions generate fifteen thousand dollars each; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Convert 60% of diligence-ready opportunities into settlements satisfying the contractual commission trigger. Retain failed inspection, lien, funding, and timing outcomes rather than deleting lost opportunities.

circle.title: label: Screened seller opportunities; value: 500 distinct equipment opportunities enter the annual cohort; numeric value: 500.0; detail: Record owner identity, asset identifier, equipment class, location, and disposition timing. Remove duplicate listings before calculating any conversion rate.

label: Signed broker mandates; value: 200 opportunities retain documented seller authority and pricing; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Convert 40% of the original cohort into signed mandates with commission terms, evidence access, and a plausible asking price; retain rejected reasons in the CRM.

label: Qualified buyer matches; value: 100 mandated opportunities secure credible buyer engagement; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Convert 50% of mandated opportunities into buyer-matched assets. Require named purchasing authority, suitable capacity requirements, and a credible funding path; email opens do not qualify.

label: Diligence-ready transactions; value: 50 matched opportunities reach documented diligence readiness; numeric value: 50.0; detail: Convert 50% of buyer-matched opportunities after inspection scheduling, ownership review, negotiated commercial terms, and a documented settlement route.

label: Settled commission events; value: 30 transactions generate fifteen thousand dollars each; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Convert 60% of diligence-ready opportunities into settlements satisfying the contractual commission trigger. Retain failed inspection, lien, funding, and timing outcomes rather than deleting lost opportunities.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative annual Base-Case planning cohort, not observed conversion data. Every count represents equipment opportunities from the same original 500-record cohort, deduplicated by owner and asset identifier. Assume 30 settled transactions, each at $250,000 equipment value and a 6% broker commission.
